entry.title: Understanding Context Engineering
entry.summary: Context engineering is the practice of designing how AI agents receive, process, and maintain context across sessions. This article covers the fundamental patterns.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Patterns
entry.summary: Patterns for orchestrating multiple AI agents in parallel and sequential workflows. Covers fan-out, pipeline, and consensus patterns.
